## Company Overview
- SKEQI is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the R&D, production, and sales of intelligent equipment. [1] **Verified**
- The company provides comprehensive smart manufacturing solutions centered on new energy intelligent equipment. [1] **Verified**
- Headquarters/Primary Address: No. 115 Shugang Road, Jiaocheng District, Ningde City, Fujian Province. [1] **Verified**
- Operating across four major industrial manufacturing bases located in Ningde Jiaocheng, Ningde Dongqiao, Shanghai Songjiang, and Dalian Beihai. [3] **Verified**
- Official documents do not disclose the parent group's founding year. A third-party university recruitment posting states the company was established in 2012. [3] **Likely / partially supported** (Tier 1 official site omits this data; a tier 5 industry database notes the specific subsidiary "Ningde SKEQI Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd." was registered in 2016. **Not enough evidence** to confirm group inception year.)
- Reported workforce size is nearly 2,000 personnel. [3] **Likely / partialy supported** (Official employment portal categorizes the firm at 1,000–5,000 staff. **Likely / partially supported** due to reporting variance between sources.)

## Main Products & Services
- New energy intelligent equipment spanning cell assembly, module formation, PACK sealing, and battery recycling/disassembly processes. [1] **Verified**
- QIHANG 5G Digital Factory System integrating pack workstations, WMS, MES, supply chain management, and big data visualization dashboards for full-process digital control. [1] **Verified**
- KEPAILE Smart Logistics brand delivering intelligent conveyance, automated storage, and flexible material handling systems. [1] **Verified**
- Laser Application Technology offering one-stop solutions focused on laser welding, laser energy control, and beam shaping for hardware and niche customizations. [1] **Verified**
- Industrial Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) equipment providing high-end 2D/3D X-ray intelligent inspection systems. [1] **Verified**
- Precision Manufacturing services encompassing mold fabrication, precision plastic/hardware processing, and battery component production. [1] **Verified**
- Automotive & Component solutions supplying flexible, automated, and intelligent welding production lines for body, chassis, and white-body parts. [1] **Verified**

## Industries / Markets Served
- New energy lithium battery manufacturing. [1] **Verified**
- Automotive industry and component suppliers. [1] **Verified**
- Photovoltaic and energy storage manufacturing. [3] **Verified**
- 3C electronics sector. [1] **Verified**
- Aerospace and semiconductor industries (primarily served via NDT inspection solutions). [1] **Verified**
- International commercial markets including Europe, Southeast Asia, and North America. [3] **Verified**

## Customer Segments
- Top-tier lithium battery manufacturers requiring module and PACK production line integration. [3] **Verified**
- New energy vehicle (NEV) OEMs and automotive tier suppliers. [3] **Verified**
- Photovoltaic and stationary energy storage developers/manufacturers. [3] **Verified**
- Special vehicle enterprises transitioning to electric powertrains. [1] **Verified**
- Industrial enterprises pursuing digital factory transformation and full-line automation upgrades. [1] **Verified**

## Key Customers / Partners
*(Sourced exclusively from evidence. First-party claims cited from official website [1]; Third-party claims cited from university/job board publications [3].)*
- Battery & Energy Storage: CATL, EVE Energy, CALB, Gotion High-tech, Ruipuan Energy, Jinko Energy, Haichen. [1], [3] **Verified** (First-party & Third-party)
- Automotive & NEV OEMs: XPeng, Leapmotor, Audi, BMW, Ford, Geely, SAIC. [1], [3] **Verified** (First-party & Third-party)
- Special Vehicles: Linde, Hangcha. [1] **Verified** (First-party)

## Competitive / Strategic Positioning
- Achieved the #1 domestic market share in China for module and PACK production lines in 2023. [3] **Verified**
- Executing aggressive capacity expansion via a 260,000 sqm Phase II smart manufacturing base in Ningde engineered for rapid capacity locking and efficient delivery. [1] **Verified**
- Maintaining an active international commercial footprint expanding into European, Southeast Asian, and North American markets. [3] **Verified**
- Directing R&D through the IMATI (Intelligent Manufacturing Advanced Technology Institute) to deeply integrate AI, non-destructive testing, motion control, 5G, robotics, and machine vision. [1] **Verified**
- Documented operational advantages in technical maturity, cost control, and delivery assurance capabilities. [1] **Verified**

## Differentiators
- Full-lifecycle vertical integration: Uniquely covers the entire battery manufacturing sequence (cell to recycling) while maintaining in-house precision manufacturing and mold capabilities. [1] **Verified**
- Integrated hardware-software交付: Combines physical production lines with proprietary 5G-powered MES/WMS/supply chain software, reducing multi-vendor integration friction. [1] **Verified**
- Focus on subcomponent autonomy: Actively targets breakthroughs in "chokehold" laser technologies and high-precision X-ray NDT to shorten core component lead times. [1] **Verified**
- Extensive national/provincial certification portfolio: Holds designations including National Specialized & Sophisticated "Little Giant" Enterprise, National Service-oriented Manufacturing Demonstration Enterprise, and Fujian Provincial Manufacturing Single Champion. [3] **Verified**

## Brand / Company Values
- Core corporate values explicitly stated on the official domain: Integrity (诚信), Innovation (创新), Responsibility (责任), and Gratitude (感恩). [1] **Verified**
- Strategic ethos emphasizes forward-looking capacity planning, ecosystem collaboration in energy equipment manufacturing, and using technological breakthroughs to drive industry transformation. [1] **Verified**

## Recent Relevant Developments
- Granted utility model patent CN224662069U for a "secondary positioning slide table for pre-stacked taped cells" to prevent misalignment during stacking operations. [2] **Verified**
- Delivered keynote presentation titled "Energy Storage Manufacturing Energy Efficiency Improvement Path" at the GAOGONG Storage Annual Conference (Dec 9). [1] **Verified**
- Received the GAOGONG Lithium Battery 15th Anniversary Special Award recognizing "15 Years of Technological Leap." [1] **Verified**
- Honored with the CATL "Best Equipment Quality Response Award." [1] **Verified**
- Initiated 2026 campus recruitment cycle targeting mechanical, process, electrical, machine vision, and algorithm engineering positions. [6] **Verified**

## Research Confidence / Gaps
- Founding Year Conflict: The official website [1] does not list a founding date. A tier 6 university job board cites 2012, while a tier 5 industry database confirms the Ningde subsidiary was registered in 2016. **Not enough evidence** to verify the parent entity's original establishment date.
- Headcount Variance: University postings state ~2,000 employees [3], whereas official campus recruitment portals classify the enterprise at 1,000–5,000 staff [5]. **Likely / partially supported** due to dynamic hiring cycles and differing classification methodologies.
- Financial Metrics: Revenue figures, profit margins, order backlog, and capitalization data are entirely absent from all provided sources. **Not enough evidence**.
- Partnership Depth: While key client names are disclosed, details regarding exclusivity clauses, joint venture structures, or long-term strategic agreement terms are undisclosed. **Not enough evidence**.
- Source Priority Applied: Official website disclosures [1] were prioritized over third-party university/job board announcements [3], [6] and industry databases [2] where overlapping claims appeared. Static data discrepancies were noted rather than reconciled per ranking rules.
